Package services

Class MastodonPostMapper

java.lang.Object
services.MastodonPostMapper
public final class MastodonPostMapper extends Object
Translates Mastodon timeline JSON into transport-independent posts.

AI assistance: implementation support for the Phase 3 request to validate Mastodon responses and keep JSON outside the domain model.

Author:
Nabeel Ali
